full_judgment: 11. It appears from record in particular from Annexure 2-5 of the supplementary affidavit to the affidavit in opposition that subsequent to suspension of the operation of the respective FDR accounts of the petitioner respondent No. 3 on conclusion of inquiry in connection with the petitioner duly sent report to the Commissioner of Taxes, Tax Zone-5, Dhaka on 17-12-2007 for consideration. (Annexure-3). Pursuant thereto tax file of the petitioner was re-opened under section 93 of the Ordinance,1984 by the Additional Commissioner of Taxes, Ranze-2, Tax Zone-5, Dhaka vide respective orders dated 18-6-2008 for the year 2002-2003, on 4-2-2009 for 2003-2004, on 7-4-2009 for the year 2004-2005, on 7-4-2009 for the year 2005-2006 and on 7-4-2009 for the assessment year 2006-2007 respectively. Ultimately, upon hearing the representative of the petitioner it was disposed of with the passing of the assessment order dated 15-6-2010 for the assessment year 2002-2003, on 28-6-2011 for the assessment year 2003-2004, on 28-6-2011 for 2004-2005, on 28-6-2011 for 2005-2006 and on 28-6-2011 for 2006-2007. (Annexure-4 and 4(A)- (D) respectively). Subsequently, after more than 6 (six) years notice had been issued by the authority concerned on 7-12-2017(Annexure-5) directing the petitioner to pay the demanded amount within 20-12-2017, in default process under sections 137/142/143 of the Ordinance, 1984 would be initiated.
